{{Quote|Bring us about, Ratt. You know where we're going.''"<br />"''Copy, Booster. Setting a course for Orbital mirror Baker Six Tango.|Booster Terrik and Ratt|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
'''Ratt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] navigation [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Booster Terrik]] aboard the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' in [[44 ABY]]. During the first ever [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]], Ratt [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] the ''Errant Venture'' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as it attacked [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|Orbital Mirrors]], distracting the [[Sixth Fleet|Galactic Alliance Sixth Fleet]]&mdash;although the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] could not return fire, due to the one hundred important governmental [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] aboard the ''Errant Venture'' for the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament&mdash;and allowing a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[StealthX]] wing to launch safely, in order to [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|help]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] on [[Pydyr]].
